retainedFailures: The first portable run passed cold legacy settings/10000-tag migration, official plugin activation, credential redaction, SVG/replay, favorite and native pause/seek; its new RGB comparison failed absolute/relative thresholds. The run exited gracefully and remains failed in the original record.

ffprobe shows untagged HD YUV420 source and BT709/sRGB-tagged full-range native PNG. A separate four-matrix diagnostic gives target-frame NMAE 0.03918 under default/BT601 and 0.00715 under explicit BT709. Comparator now uses the matching matrix; original 0.015 absolute and 0.5 relative thresholds are unchanged. The original PNG independently passes at frame330/11s, rather than silently discarding the failure.

After the first owned process was terminal, verification resumed using its existing Data and durable 11s progress/favorite. It first proves resume, uses the real UI to establish a distinct 5s control then seeks to 11s again, completes geometry/cleanup checks, and restarts once more. No profile reset or production rebuild hides the failed attempt.

Installer inspection initially looked for an uninstalled 7zip-bin Node module; the already-used builder cache 7za executable was then located from its live build log. Installer extraction and ASAR match passed.

limits: No actual NSIS installation/upgrade was performed. Payload extraction, PE/version/update/hash/signature checks and actual copied portable execution do not replace interactive install/upgrade matrices.
This fresh build has short native startup/playback/restart/layout checks, not a repeated 20-minute resource acceptance. Previous R6 long-run evidence stays attached to its older frozen ASAR.
Two copied synthetic H264/AAC clips and 10000 generated tag keys are used; this is not 10000 distinct media contents or physical phone/LAN acceptance.

Legacy synchronous plugin/settings APIs, other full configuration consumers, large extension callbacks and renderer data preparation remain. Whole cold-start latency and two-second interaction budget are not established.
Physical Android 60-minute PSS/FPS/LAN, other Windows/media matrices, iOS, signing/identity migration, historical theme drift and cloud/public delivery remain open.
